A Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) is a network that learns a map between whole fields, such as an initial condition and the pattern it grows into, by mixing information in the frequency domain [@li2021fourier].

The goal is an inverse that needs a single forward pass: given a target pattern, return the initial condition or the parameter fields that produce it.
The [Diffusion Controller](../diffusion-controller/index.qmd) reaches the same answer only after many denoising passes, so a one-pass operator would make inverse design far cheaper.
The intended systems are the Gray-Scott reaction–diffusion model, see [Pattern Forcing](../gray-scott-inversion/index.qmd), and a surrogate of liquid metal dealloying, whose final fields are shown in the banner above.
